name: 80129 · Hghlnds Ranch, CO
findings: ZIP 80129 (Hghlnds Ranch) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80129 (Hghlnds Ranch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80129 (Hghlnds Ranch) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
